business_summary: Safie Inc. develops and operates a cloud-based video recording platform under the Safie brand in Japan. The company provides cloud security cameras, such as Safie One, VIVOTEK FD9166-HN (SF), AXIS M5074PTZ, VIVOTEK FD9186-H(SF), i-PRO WV-U1532LAUX(SF), i-PRO WV-U1532LA(SF), Safie GO 360, Safie GO PTZ Plus, Safie GO PTZ, Safie GO 180, AXIS P1468-XLE, Orient Brain RC-360BL, Safie PT CAM, VIVOTEK FD9383-HV(2.8mm)(SF), Safie Pocket2 Plus, and Safie Pocket2. Its products are used in various industries, including retail, food service, construction, logistics, manufacturing, infrastructure, public services, and healthcare. Safie Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Safie Inc.는 일본에서 Safie 브랜드로 클라우드 기반 비디오 녹화 플랫폼을 개발 및 운영하고 있습니다. 회사는 Safie One, VIVOTEK FD9166-HN (SF), AXIS M5074PTZ, VIVOTEK FD9186-H(SF), i-PRO WV-U1532LAUX(SF), i-PRO WV-U1532LA(SF), Safie GO 360, Safie GO PTZ Plus, Safie GO PTZ, Safie GO 180, AXIS P1468-XLE, Orient Brain RC-360BL, Safie PT CAM, VIVOTEK FD9383-HV(2.8mm)(SF), Safie Pocket2 Plus 및 Safie Pocket2. 해당 제품은 소매, 식품 서비스, 건설, 물류, 제조, 인프라, 공공 서비스, 의료 등 다양한 산업에서 사용됩니다. Safie Inc.는 2014년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
